name: string-not-terminated
title: Do not treat unterminated bytes as a C string
lesson: A byte buffer is not a C string unless it has a terminating NUL within its bounds.
fix_goal: Track lengths explicitly or reserve space for a NUL terminator.
fix_steps: Distinguish counted byte buffers from C strings.
Reserve one byte for the terminator when creating a C string.
Re-run the lab and confirm the terminator is present.
